findings.title: ECC certificate is vulnerable to future quantum attacks
findings.description: This endpoint uses ECC-based public-key cryptography. RSA, ECC, and DSA are considered vulnerable to a future cryptographically relevant quantum computer.
findings.recommendation: Track this asset in a CBOM and prioritize migration based on data sensitivity and confidentiality lifetime.

readiness_score_factors.reason: ECC public-key cryptography should be tracked for post-quantum migration.
The endpoint is publicly reachable, so cryptographic posture is externally visible.
TLS 1.3 is modern classical TLS, but it is not automatically post-quantum safe.
The confidentiality lifetime is unknown, so harvest-now-decrypt-later urgency cannot be ranked yet.

summary.plain_english: This asset uses public-key cryptography that should be tracked for post-quantum migration. No private data was required to generate this CBOM.

trust_receipt.plain_english: This CBOM was generated locally from public TLS certificate metadata. No private keys, source code, logs, customer data, secrets, or internal infrastructure maps were collected or sent to external AI.
